$comment: The compare contract, v1. Kept identically in slskd (docs/transfers-compare-provider.schema.json) and media-bridge (contracts/compare-v1.schema.json); each repo's tests hold its side to its copy. Change both, and bump `contract` only for a change a caller cannot ignore. Unknown fields are allowed everywhere so a provider can add more without coordinating. Every index is into `files`, which is in the order the caller sent.
title: Compare provider response

verdict.description: The answer, before the detail: the dialog's banner.

level.description: same: beyond doubt. likely: the same, a looser match. mixed: some are, some are not. partly: long stretches shared, then they part. different: none are. unknown: fewer than two could be read.

files.description: One per file sent, in the order sent.

note.description: Why not, for a file that is not readable. The same words whatever the reason.

music_s.description: The music's length, silence trimmed off both ends.

groups.description: Files that are one track, largest first; each has two or more. `notes` is one per member, the first being the one the others are compared with.

alone.description: Readable files that are the same as nothing else sent.

partly.description: Pairs sharing long stretches and then parting: an edit, an extended mix, a mashup. A pair, not a group.

pairs.description: Optional: the measurements behind the words, every readable pair. A client drawing the answer does not need them.
